description: This file defines the 'Support' model class in the Goteo project, representing support or collaboration entries associated with projects. It includes methods for fetching, validating, saving, and deleting support entries, as well as retrieving related message threads.

classes.name: Support
classes.description: Represents a support entry related to a project, including support type, description, thread messages, and related data. Provides methods for CRUD operations, message thread management, and validation.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the fields that require language localization, namely 'support' and 'description'.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: Sets language-specific data for the support entry, delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a support record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all support records associated with a specific project, optionally localized to a given language.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the support object ensuring a project is assigned.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts or updates the support record in the database after validation.

methods.name: getThread
methods.description: Retrieves the message thread associated with this support entry.

methods.name: getThreadResponses
methods.description: Retrieves responses from the message thread, optionally filtering private messages.

methods.name: totalThreadResponses
methods.description: Returns the count of responses in the message thread, optionally filtering private messages.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes the support entry and its related message from the database.

methods.name: types
methods.description: Returns an array of supported support types with localized labels.
